interface.longDescription:
Schedule, post and cross-post to TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, X, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky and Google Business Profile from the assistant, then reschedule, fix failed posts, read analytics and run approvals. Schedchie is a social media scheduler with a hosted MCP server: you and the assistant write the post, and Schedchie publishes it on the accounts you pick at the time you set.

Platforms: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Google Business Profile, Discord, Slack, WordPress, Dev.to, Hashnode, Ghost, Pixelfed, Listmonk and X. Posting to X is included in every paid plan under fair use.

Ask the assistant to:
- schedule a TikTok video for tomorrow at 9:00 and post the same video to Instagram as a Reel
- cross-post one announcement to LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Threads and Bluesky, with different text per network
- move a scheduled post, edit it, or retry one that failed and say why it failed
- upload images and video from a link, or get an upload link for a file on your computer
- show what is scheduled next week and what went out last week
- report followers, posts published and per-post numbers on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Google Business Profile and Discord
- find the best times to post from each account's own history
- approve or reject posts teammates hold for review, and share client review links
- read and answer comments on published posts

When you sign in, you choose what the connection may do, in six permission groups: posts, media, analytics, team and approvals, notes and presets, and comments and mentions. Deleting a post, removing a member or disconnecting an account is marked destructive, so the assistant asks before it runs.

You need a Schedchie account. Create one on the sign-in screen; the tools answer once it has an active plan or trial. Social accounts are connected in the Schedchie web app.
